purpose: Shows that something is loading when the time it takes is unknown, as a small square spinning on a track.

props.name: label
props.description: What is loading, announced as a status. Defaults to Loading

whenToUse: For short waits of unknown length inside a region, such as loading a list
whenNotToUse: For long or measurable work — use ProgressBar
Inside a button — Button has its own loading state
antiPatterns: Several spinners on one screen at once

anatomy: A square on a neutral track, rotating; a visually hidden label; under reduced motion the label shows as text instead

a11yNotes: role status with the label, so screen readers announce it
No motion under prefers-reduced-motion; the label shows instead
